name: gaps
description: Regression cases from the 2026-10-13 gap audit (docs/reviews/gap-audit-2026-10-13.md): handoffs to the owning skill, one question, no invented claims. Run with --suite gaps; G06 page chrome in motion review (2026-10-14).

cases.title: Caption Studio sends missing wording to Copy Voice (gap audit GAP-04)

turns.prompt: /framecore-work-creative-studio:caption-studio Wymyśl treść napisów reklamowych do rolki lampki biurkowej, bo nie mam tekstu.

rubric: The words come from Copy Voice; Caption Studio does not write the ad copy itself

cases.title: Humanizer hands new copy to Copy Voice and adds no comfort claim (GAP-03, GAP-04)

turns.prompt: /framecore-work-creative-studio:humanizer Napisz od zera opis produktu lampki biurkowej do sklepu.

rubric: New copy goes to Copy Voice; no health or comfort claim without source facts

cases.title: Video Prompt Architect asks one question when essentials are missing (GAP-06)
Asset Manifest keeps haslo.txt as the slogan, not a credential (GAP-05)

turns.prompt: /framecore-work-creative-studio:asset-manifest Pliki projektu: plakat_v1.psd, plakat_v2_final.psd, plakat_v2_final_POPRAWKA.psd, logo.svg, packshot_01.jpg, packshot_02.jpg, haslo.txt. Zrób manifest.

rubric: haslo.txt is listed as the slogan or as a role to confirm, never excluded as a credential

cases.title: Copy Voice never claims a no-break space the reply does not contain (GAP-02)

turns.prompt: /framecore-work-creative-studio:copy-voice Napisz 3 nagłówki i CTA do posta o lampce biurkowej. Fakty zablokowane: cena 199 zł, 3 barwy światła, ściemniacz. Nie dodawaj innych cech.

rubric: No claim of an inserted U+00A0 unless the text has it; a note to insert one is fine

cases.title: A planned reel carries no page chrome and keeps the ad's real information (motionmaxxing review, owner 2026-10-14)

turns.prompt: /framecore-work-creative-studio:hyperframes-workflow Zaplanuj kadry 15-sekundowej rolki 9:16 dla pizzerii Forno Nero, którą zbuduję w HyperFrames. Hasło: „Pizza z pieca opalanego drewnem”. Oferta: −20% we wtorki. Telefon 600 100 200, ul. Długa 5. Pomysł wybierz sam. Daj tabelę kadrów z opisem, co i gdzie jest na ekranie.

rubric: No chapter counter, progress bar, timecode, kicker over a headline or repeated left-headline-plus-card slide layout
The end card keeps the phone number and address
